decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the outbuilding hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted numbered 314, 314/01, 314/02, 314/EX2, Design & Access Statement Received 25/08/2010  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the northern elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank wall of the outbuilding hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - No cooking of hot food shall be undertaken within the development hereby approved.
description: Erection of detached outbuilding for ancillary use by the existing restaurant
